ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited is commencing the mandatory transfer of equity shares and associated unclaimed dividends to the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) for shareholders whose dividends have remained uncollected for seven consecutive years or more (since FY 2018-19). This compliance action requires affected shareholders to claim their dues by October 15, 2026, or their shares and dividends will be moved to the IEPF, necessitating a more complex reclamation process. While it highlights inactive shareholder accounts, this is a procedural compliance matter and presents no immediate financial red flags for the company itself.
